mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining relative to its 12-month MA, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 thousand units and real personal consumption expenditures exceed 370 billion dollars, it signals robust economic growth that boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong housing and consumer spending regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising relative to its 12-month MA, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST < 1400 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in the Consumer Price Index exceeds 0.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate consistently indicates a tightening labor market that supports higher corporate hiring and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is declining, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.
